scope: Staged Poet native consumer implementation; no Core replacement, sibling mutation, build or GPU execution by viewport worker.
canonical_editable_source: Existing vibe::session::SourceSession via CanonicalEditorHost remains sole editable state. Viewport holds derived CompiledAssembly and SourceRef only.

reused.result: One lazily created device per native InteractivePreviewProvider; automatic previews and camera frames retain admitted geometry/material/UV resources. Bare geometry preserves Core's generated normal frames and exposes no fabricated source part. Operation counters expose actual creation/upload/frame invocation counts, not performance measurements.
Canonical clamp, projection, eye and forward direction. Screen axes recovered from canonical projection rows. Extent clamps aspect to the same 0.05 floor as Core.
Clip/depth validation and overlay projection use Core matrix transforms; no private matrix multiply/inverse implementation.
Canonical vector normalization for screen axes.
Canonical zero-heap triangle intersection; closest in-clip depth maps the exact triangle index to existing CompiledPart range/key/semantic_id.
Existing compiled triangle/part/range mapping retained. No scene codec, graph identity substitute, independent geometry compiler or authored state engine.
Existing geometry/material admission and HMC digest/texture-role upload pipeline preserved; shared settings validation extracted narrowly from existing one-shot renderer.
Source revalidation before and after publication and in bounded selection loops. Root provider must additionally invalidate on execution epoch/authority retirement.

inspected_not_substituted.reason: Existing GPU picker identifies a visible mesh instance, whereas current Poet assembly uploads all source parts as one combined mesh. It does not return source triangle/part ranges. CPU geometric pick uses existing Core triangle kernel to close consumer mapping without changing Core or confusing graph nodes with mesh parts.

camera_frame_node frames an origin-relative graph point, not arbitrary assembly/part AABBs. Poet input adapter computes fit distance for the source bounds using canonical FOV/zoom limits; no competing orbit/projection state implementation.

qualification_limits: Square 8..1024 native offscreen attachment is presented through existing PreviewFrame/Aether data URI path; retained Portal GPU rendering does not itself prove native direct-surface presentation or GUI interaction acceptance.
Picking is geometric opaque static-mesh selection. Alpha-mask, blended and wind-deformed material cases fail closed. CPU/GPU raster edge agreement and all material profiles remain unqualified.

Selection highlight is explicitly x-ray wireframe, drawn only for fully on-screen triangles in the selected source part. It shows occluded edges, does not claim depth-correct outlines and does not modify material or texture factors.
GPU submission/readback remains synchronous through existing Core API. Cancellation checks bracket submission/readback; an already submitted GPU operation is not interrupted.
Caller-selected CPU working-byte, triangle and overlay-step limits gate new work. Core owns GPU and texture admission. No measured frame rate, latency or GPU-memory claim is made.

The stage contains seven ordinary tests and two explicitly ignored headless GPU tests. The provider GPU case evaluates actual Vibe source, exercises automatic preview and raw SourceSession parts gestures, checks device/upload reuse, exact visible part selection and old-context frame invalidation, and verifies bare-geometry compatibility without fabricated source parts. Tests were staged and rustfmt completed; root integration owns execution evidence and native owner/UI closure. No human acceptance is asserted.
